name: After the End
source:
Ever since the world ended BB has been alone. The only survivor, BB, journeys in the hopes of finding someone else alive. Stumbling upon a town far from the ruins of civilization can BB dare to hope? Or will there just be more death?

[From [url=https://stomachgod.itch.io/after-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界终结后，BB一直独自生活。作为唯一幸存者，BB踏上旅程，希望找到其他活着的人。她偶然发现一座远离文明废墟的小镇，敢于抱有希望吗？还是那里只会带来更多死亡？

[来源：[url=https://stomachgod.itch.io/after-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
